description.ja: Mistral AI初の推論特化モデル。2025年6月10日公開。Mistral Small 3.1ベース。透明で多段階の論理的推論を実現。Chain-of-Thoughtアプローチ。多言語対応。OpenAI o1のような推論能力を目指す。エンタープライズ向け高忠実度推論。
description.en: Mistral AI's first reasoning-focused model. Released June 10, 2025. Based on Mistral Small 3.1. Enables transparent, multi-step logical reasoning. Chain-of-Thought approach. Multilingual support. Aims for o1-like reasoning capabilities. Enterprise-grade high-fidelity reasoning.

description.en: Reasoning model based on Mistral Small 3.1. Apache 2.0 license.
